# isoplane daemon :since[next]

Run the local multi-application host in the foreground. Requires isoplaned on PATH.

```bash
isoplane daemon [options]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <config>` :since[next] | Required. Host configuration file. |
| `--check` :since[next] | Validate the host configuration without serving traffic. |
| `--print-config` :since[next] | Print effective host configuration without application secrets. |
